sealing_policy.generation_validation: Structural and legality validation used python-chess only; no agent or chess engine was run against any promotion suite during generation.
sealing_policy.policy: Promotion A is the next available promotion validation set. Once used for a promotion decision it is consumed, and Promotion B becomes next. Promotion C is reserved after B. A consumed suite must never be reused to tune a candidate.

criteria.check: side to move is not in check
criteria.evaluation: highest-depth evaluation, first PV; no mate; abs(cp) <= 50
criteria.fen_counters: history-free normalization to halfmove 0 and fullmove 1
criteria.strata: phase, side to move, capture availability, and (outside endgames) castling rights
criteria.terminal: non-terminal; no pre-root history; sufficient material

selection.method: per-stratum reservoir sampling independently within each fixed source window; deterministic final shuffle

phase_definition.units: queen=4, rook=2, bishop=1, knight=1; both colors; maximum 24

source.evaluation_source: Stockfish evaluations contributed through Lichess analysis
